quote: Rule: before anything gets published to the website, I will have to approve it. Others can only push to git
scope: Every future website release, including automated batches and preview/discovery/release modes.

enforcement.workflow: manual workflow_dispatch; main; repository-owner actor; publish_approved input
enforcement.self_review_setting_reason: Ahimanikya is both the permitted initiator and sole approver; this GitHub setting permits his own human approval, not AI self-approval.
enforcement.verification: GitHub API read-back after saving reviewer and bypass settings

limits: No deployment was triggered to test the gate. Configuration and retained remote workflow were verified.
Future agents must not approve a GitHub job through the owner session without his explicit approval of that exact release.
No collaborator privileges, invitations, secrets, DNS or runtime settings changed.
